package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"

	"example.com/godj-project-bundle/authors"
	"example.com/godj-project-bundle/blog"
	"example.com/godj-project-bundle/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/query"
)

type backend struct{}

func (*backend) Query(context.Context, query.Plan) (db.Rows, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (*backend) Insert(context.Context, query.InsertPlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (*backend) Update(context.Context, query.UpdatePlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

func (*backend) Delete(context.Context, query.DeletePlan) (int64, error) {
	return 0, nil
}

var (
	_ project.Backend = (*backend)(nil)

	_ json.Marshaler   = project.BlogPost{}
	_ json.Marshaler   = (*project.BlogPost)(nil)
	_ json.Unmarshaler = (*project.BlogPost)(nil)

	_ func(project.BlogPost) string          = project.BlogPost.DisplayTitle
	_ func(*project.BlogPost)                = (*project.BlogPost).NormalizeTitle
	_ func(project.BlogPost) ([]byte, error) = project.BlogPost.MarshalJSON
	_ func(*project.BlogPost, []byte) error  = (*project.BlogPost).UnmarshalJSON
)

func compileCanonicalFacade(ctx context.Context, origin project.Backend) error {
	models, err := project.Using(origin)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	author, err := models.AuthorsAuthor.New(authors.Author{Name: "Ada"})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	post, err := models.BlogPost.New(blog.Post{Title: "draft", AuthorID: 1})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	post.Title = post.Title + "!"
	var title string = post.DisplayTitle()
	_ = title
	post.NormalizeTitle()

	post, err = post.WithAuthor(author)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	post, err = post.WithAuthorID(1)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := post.Author(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := post.Save(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	raw, err := post.Unwrap()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var rawPost blog.Post = raw
	_ = rawPost

	_, _ = json.Marshal(post)
	_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte("{}"), post)

	loaded, found, err := models.BlogPost.
		Filter(blog.PostFields.Title.Exact("normalized:draft!")).
		First(ctx)
	if err != nil || !found {
		return err
	}
	loaded.Title = "loaded"
	loaded.NormalizeTitle()
	return nil
}
